items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1962-09-19
items.q: I believe the Duke of Windsor, when he was Prince of Wales, once said, I'd rather hear Louis Armstrong play Chinatown than wander into Westminster Abbey and find the lost chord.

ctx.x: Gentlemen, we've got two more chords to go, so we'll have a quick one from Eric Marsden.

Mr. Armstrong, what about the tribute? You must have had many in your lifetime. I believe the Duke of Windsor, when he was Prince of Wales, once said, I'd rather hear Louis Armstrong play Chinatown than wander into Westminster Abbey and find the lost chord.
